Photo too big to send? 📷 Make it half the size in a few taps.

1. Open image.315tools.com and tap Resize
2. Add your photo
3. Tap Percent. Half the size is already set
4. Tap Convert and save your smaller photo

Free · No sign-up · Your photos never leave your device 🔒
